## Introduction

This is a short report about the **Palmer Penguins** dataset. The data contains measurements for three penguin species:

- *Adelie*
- *Chinstrap*
- *Gentoo*

You can find more information about the data on the [palmerpenguins website](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/).

The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` penguins.

## Analysis

```{r}
#| include: false
summary_penguins <- summarize(
  penguins,
  mean = mean(flipper_len, na.rm = TRUE),
  .by = species
)
summary_penguins
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
